items.title: Mighty Max
items.description: Mighty Max is an animated action/horror television series created by Mark Zaslove and Rob Hudnut based on the British Mighty Max toys, an outgrowth of the Polly Pocket line created by Bluebird Toys in 1992.[1] The series originally aired in syndication as part of a children's block titled Amazin' Ad
